title: Fall in Nashville-Cozy Townhome 10 min to Broadway
description:
Chic tri-level open-concept townhome just minutes from all the excitement in Downtown Nashville. Relax on the patio with gas fire bowl until it is time to hit the World Famous Honky Tonks! Fully equipped kitchen including Keurig for making coffee or tea after a long night out. Extremely convenient to all the hot eateries of East Nashville, and you can even walk to Crema, a local coffee shop down the block. 

We can’t wait to host you & your friends and family on your Nashville adventure!
